newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says no settlement yet of Busang dispute.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says no settlement yet of Busang dispute.

text.p: Indonesia's director-general of mining Kuntoro Mangkusubroto said on Wednesday an ownership dispute between Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and a local partner over the Busang gold find remained unresolved.
"There is nothing new at the moment. We are still holding on to the contract of work until they solve their internal dispute," Kuntoro told Reuters.
Indonesian Jusuf Merukh is claiming 40 percent of the find in East Kalimantan, estimated to contain at least 47 million ounces of gold. Bre-X has rejected his claim.
The government is holding up contracts of work, which Bre-X needs to continue exploration and development of the property, until the ownership dispute is settled.
